text:
{
  "candidate": "cand_0001",
  "headline": "Verified that a regex fast-path bypasses orchestrator.md for 53/67 val tasks, so spent the budget on shared_context.md + domain files; corrected three FALSE baseline rules that were themselves causing failures, and added cross-domain rules for result-scope misreading, epoch conversion, directory-vs-file fetches, and do-the-feasible-read.",
  "clusters": [
    {
      "id": "A",
      "name": "Fast-path routes to an agent lacking the required tool",
      "detail": "classify_fast() (agents.py:256) runs before the orchestrator LLM; on a match orchestrator.py:1202 dispatches a sub-agent and returns, so orchestrator.md is never read (53/67 tasks). The matched agent frequently has no tool for the task's data source and cannot hand off, so it substitutes another source or declares the data unavailable. NOT fixable by any prompt edit; ~3.4 task-points.",
      "tasks": ["cloud-304-marketplace-active-past-end", "cloud-315-min-cost-drops-unestimated", "platform-071-unmonitored-proxy-not-esxi-alert", "icinga-013-acknowledged-not-an-issue", "cloud-074-assigned-account-still-billing", "cloud-310-stopped-lab-restarted-billing"],
      "scope": "SYSTEMIC",
      "latent": false,
      "tag": "CAPABILITY-GAP"
    },
    {
      "id": "B",
      "name": "Directory path fetched as a file, then search thrash to round exhaustion",
      "detail": "The prompt stated 'fetch_github_file - Fetch files and directories'; in practice a directory path errors. Agents fetched a catalog item's directory path, got not-found, then spent every remaining round on empty searches and ended with 'I've used all my planned tool calls', which grades as no answer.",
      "tasks": ["platform-121-near-miss-pick-partner-repo", "platform-032-shared-secret-not-a-registry-outage", "platform-007-directory-path-fetch", "platform-137-generated-password-forbidden-chars", "platform-104-cfn-dependency-and-what-changed"],
      "scope": "WIDESPREAD",
      "latent": false,
      "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"
    },
    {
      "id": "C",
      "name": "Unix epoch timestamps converted by eye",
      "detail": "No prompt file carried any epoch-conversion guidance. Agents converted epoch seconds mentally and landed hours or whole months off, which inverted every derived 'has it expired / is it still in effect / how long ago' conclusion even when the verdict logic was right.",
      "tasks": ["icinga-215-ack-comment-author-and-expiry", "icinga-204-downtime-window-expired", "icinga-206-stale-ok-check", "icinga-216-flexible-downtime-duration", "icinga-212-fix-on-main-not-on-pinned-ref"],
      "scope": "BOUNDED",
      "latent": false,
      "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"
    },
    {
      "id": "D",
      "name": "A result's own qualifying fields ignored before using its numbers",
      "detail": "Results carry self-describing fields that limit what their main number means: an aggregate scope label, a clamped period, placeholder zeros for metrics the query never requested, an absent field, or a stale refresh time. Agents reported or combined the headline figure as if it answered the question asked.",
      "tasks": ["cost-407-aws-historical-query-came-back-org-wide", "cost-408-three-cloud-total-gcp-query-failed", "cost-418-capacity-window-starts-mid-review", "cost-402-unused-cost-preset-has-no-utilisation", "cost-051-gcp-net-of-credits"],
      "scope": "WIDESPREAD",
      "latent": false,
      "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"
    },
    {
      "id": "E",
      "name": "Refusing or asking instead of running the feasible read",
      "detail": "When one part of a request was impossible (a write with read-only tools) or an identifier looked malformed, agents answered with ZERO tool calls - 8/10 and 10/10 trials respectively - often offering to run a query they were already able to run.",
      "tasks": ["cloud-057-cloudtrail-select-only-refusal", "cloud-058-malformed-account-id"],
      "scope": "BOUNDED",
      "latent": false,
      "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"
    },
    {
      "id": "F",
      "name": "Wrong AAP2 job action; failed-events read skipped",
      "detail": "aap2_agent.md said 'Always use get_job_log instead of get_job' (twice), so the pinned get_job call went unmatched. Separately 'also call get_job_events failed_only' sat inside a GUID-only flow and was skipped when the user supplied a job id, so the failing role was inferred from the env_type name instead of read from the event row.",
      "tasks": ["platform-126-stop-job-from-tower-jobs", "platform-116-timeout-headroom-from-history", "platform-004-events-then-config"],
      "scope": "BOUNDED",
      "latent": false,
      "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"
    },
    {
      "id": "G",
      "name": "Answer-surface defects hide correct facts",
      "detail": "Facts were present but unreadable: a status icon placed between an entity's name and its state, question-shaped headings asserting a refuted claim, thousands separators inside non-currency counts, and bold/backticks splitting a key phrase.",
      "tasks": ["icinga-045-hosts-search-filter", "icinga-204-downtime-window-expired", "icinga-201-soft-critical-not-yet-hard", "platform-116-timeout-headroom-from-history", "platform-101-vcpu-quota-from-catalog-sizing", "platform-153-override-uses-removed-variable-name"],
      "scope": "WIDESPREAD",
      "latent": false,
      "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"
    },
    {
      "id": "H",
      "name": "Lifecycle cost split estimated; verdict hedged",
      "detail": "Splitting a daily cost series at a provision/teardown boundary was done by rate-times-days rather than by summing the exact daily rows, and go/no-go questions got conditional approvals ('proceed with caution') where the record contradicted the money.",
      "tasks": ["cost-419-chargeback-predates-current-tenant", "cost-410-released-sandbox-still-spending"],
      "scope": "BOUNDED",
      "latent": false,
      "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"
    },
    {
      "id": "I",
      "name": "Line number asked for, never given or miscounted",
      "detail": "fetch_github_file returns content without line numbers. Agents quoted the deciding line's text but gave no number at all (10/10 trials on two tasks), or counted in their head and were off by one or two.",
      "tasks": ["platform-152-path-search-cannot-find-variable-uses", "platform-153-override-uses-removed-variable-name", "platform-136-provision-key-mode-too-open", "platform-101-vcpu-quota-from-catalog-sizing"],
      "scope": "BOUNDED",
      "latent": false,
      "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"
    },
    {
      "id": "J",
      "name": "Single-field tool knowledge gaps",
      "detail": "Four separate missing documented facts: the reliable lowercase CloudTrail caller column (arn comes back null); command_endpoint/check_source meaning the check ran on another machine; describe_instances being single-region so the region must come from the provisioning record; and the DNS negative-TTL rule.",
      "tasks": ["cloud-057-cloudtrail-select-only-refusal", "cloud-317-namesake-user-other-account", "icinga-222-lag-check-runs-on-satellite", "platform-158-lab-instances-outside-default-region", "platform-148-precheck-caches-nxdomain", "platform-112-exec-pool-disk-not-the-bastion"],
      "scope": "BOUNDED",
      "latent": false,
      "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"
    }
  ],
  "edits": [
    {
      "id": "E1",
      "title": "Correct three FALSE baseline statements that were themselves causing failures",
      "files": ["aap2_agent.md", "babylon_agent.md"],
      "lever": "BEHAVIORAL",
      "clusters": ["B", "F", "J"],
      "blast_radius": "MODERATE",
      "verified": "Grepped each line in the baseline: aap2_agent.md:31/490 'Fetch files and directories' + ':60/:91 Always use get_job_log instead of get_job' + ':505 search_aap2_logs with the controller hostname / cluster_host_id'. Each maps to a 9-10/10-trial unmatched expected call (platform-121 common.yaml, platform-126/116 get_job, platform-112 controller short name). These are deletions of causal text, not added prose."
    },
    {
      "id": "E2",
      "title": "Result-scope discipline: read a result's self-describing fields before using its numbers",
      "files": ["shared_context.md", "cost_agent.md"],
      "lever": "KNOWLEDGE",
      "clusters": ["D", "A"],
      "blast_radius": "WIDE",
      "verified": "cost-407's single row was {account_id: 'org-wide', total: 61842.55} and was booked to the account in 10/10 trials. Rule now says to find the entity in the row's item KEY first (protects cost-073, whose linked-account rows are org-wide-labelled with the account as the key - a reviewer confirmed this against that task's seed) and only then treat it as an aggregate. Also covers clamped periods (cost-418), preset placeholder zeros (cost-402), absent fields (cost-051) and failed inputs (cost-408)."
    },
    {
      "id": "E3",
      "title": "Epoch conversion: month-anchor table, div/mod arithmetic, one worked example",
      "files": ["icinga_agent.md"],
      "lever": "KNOWLEDGE",
      "clusters": ["C"],
      "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
      "verified": "Recomputed all 36 anchors (2025-2027) against calendar.timegm - all correct. Checked each target: 1794952800 -> 2026-11-17 22:00 (agent wrote 11-17 06:00), 1794190500 -> 2026-11-09 02:15, 1795298400 -> 2026-11-21 22:00. Placed in icinga_agent.md rather than shared_context.md after confirming no non-icinga task has epoch values in its tool results - correct blast radius and 50+ tasks avoid the token cost. Worked example uses a neutral epoch (1781234567 -> 2026-06-12 03:22 UTC, arithmetic verified), NOT any task's graded value."
    },
    {
      "id": "E4",
      "title": "Repository file fetching by path shape, plus a bounded stop-and-answer rule",
      "files": ["shared_context.md", "babylon_agent.md", "aap2_agent.md"],
      "lever": "BEHAVIORAL",
      "clusters": ["B"],
      "blast_radius": "MODERATE",
      "verified": "platform-121: all 10 trials fetched the bare directory from a similar_items row then exhausted rounds; the path-shape rule produces exactly the unmatched expected call. Stop rule deliberately narrowed to 'same tool, same target, and no different source left to try' after a reviewer showed the broad version would have cut platform-062 (passing) short in 4/10 trials, where broadening after an empty result is how it succeeds."
    },
    {
      "id": "E5",
      "title": "Do the feasible reads, then decline the rest; never repair a malformed identifier",
      "files": ["shared_context.md"],
      "lever": "BEHAVIORAL",
      "clusters": ["E"],
      "blast_radius": "MODERATE",
      "verified": "cloud-057 made 0 calls in 8/10 trials, two of them literally offering 'I'll run the count query now. Just confirm.' cloud-058 made 0 calls in 10/10. Rule forces the read and an explicit could-not-retrieve sentence. The 'when advising against an action, do not describe how someone else could carry it out' clause was added because a reviewer EXECUTED platform-118's verify.py and showed my first draft's 'name who can do it' triggered its forbidden 'recreate' item."
    },
    {
      "id": "E6",
      "title": "AAP2 job action selection by what the question needs",
      "files": ["aap2_agent.md", "babylon_agent.md"],
      "lever": "BEHAVIORAL",
      "clusters": ["F"],
      "blast_radius": "MODERATE",
      "verified": "get_job for timing/outcome, get_job_log for log text, get_job_events failed_only for EVERY failed job regardless of whether you started from a GUID or a job id, with role/host taken from the event row. platform-004's one passing trial is the one that made this call. Contracts match by subset so an extra leading get_job cannot break the 46 tasks expecting get_job_log."
    },
    {
      "id": "E7",
      "title": "Answer-surface contract: plain sentence per question, state word after the name, finding-shaped headings, bare-digit counts",
      "files": ["shared_context.md"],
      "lever": "CONTRACT",
      "clusters": ["G"],
      "blast_radius": "WIDE",
      "verified": "A reviewer ran platform-116's verify.py: '5,320s' fails the count matcher's digit-boundary guard and removing the comma raises 6/10 trials; the rule's 'no task failed' phrasing does NOT trip its forbidden item. Currency is exempted so cost-028/073/416 keep $12,400. The 'do not list ruled-out causes' clause was rewritten to 'refute a cause the user proposed, do not volunteer your own' after a reviewer showed the blunt version suppressed the refutations platform-118 and platform-067 are graded on."
    },
    {
      "id": "E8",
      "title": "Lifecycle cost-series split and unconditional verdicts",
      "files": ["shared_context.md"],
      "lever": "KNOWLEDGE",
      "clusters": ["H"],
      "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
      "verified": "Boundary from the lifecycle record or the gap in the series; exact daily sums that must reconcile to the period total; no rate-times-days estimates; unconditional hold verdict when spend contradicts a teardown. Placed beside the existing attribution-by-window rule it extends. Honest limit: cost-419's trials got the boundary right and the ARITHMETIC wrong, which prose can only nag about, so expected gain is partial."
    },
    {
      "id": "E9",
      "title": "Line-number citation by mechanical counting",
      "files": ["shared_context.md"],
      "lever": "CONTRACT",
      "clusters": ["I"],
      "blast_radius": "MODERATE",
      "verified": "platform-152 and -153 gave no line number at all in 20/20 trials. Rule requires the NUMBER, counting from line 1 of content with blank/--- lines counted, and citing the DECLARING line rather than a nested property line - the latter wording chosen after a reviewer showed 'not the start of the block' would have steered platform-104 away from its graded line. Example snippet is generic (some_key: «redacted» Expected to be followed inconsistently; may add variance."
    },
    {
      "id": "E10",
      "title": "Four documented tool/protocol facts",
      "files": ["security_agent.md", "icinga_agent.md", "aap2_agent.md"],
      "lever": "KNOWLEDGE",
      "clusters": ["J"],
      "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
      "verified": "userIdentity.username (lowercase) is the only mapped caller column, so re-run with it when a user-identity column is null (cloud-057 reported the caller 'not captured' from a null arn in 10/10). command_endpoint != host_name means the check ran elsewhere, so query that machine's services with get_services not get_hosts (icinga-222's one scoring trial is the one that did). describe_instances is single-region so take the region from the provisioning record and never read an empty region as 'nothing launched'. DNS negative TTL = min(SOA record TTL, SOA minimum)."
    },
    {
      "id": "E11",
      "title": "Stale status decided from dates, not the status word",
      "files": ["security_agent.md", "shared_context.md"],
      "lever": "KNOWLEDGE",
      "clusters": ["D", "A"],
      "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
      "verified": "Baseline already said 'always compare agreement_end against today's date' and agents trusted status anyway, so the rule was sharpened: decide from agreement_end + auto_renew against the user's as-of date, cite last_updated as the staleness evidence, and quote the stored status without asserting it. The shared version was re-scoped to a refresh time vs an event date in the SAME record after a reviewer showed my first draft made every last_check 'stale' (which would have made passing icinga tasks hedge)."
    },
    {
      "id": "E12",
      "title": "Minimal orchestrator routing fix: route by data source, resolve identifiers first, finish unrun steps",
      "files": ["orchestrator.md"],
      "lever": "BEHAVIORAL",
      "clusters": ["A", "J"],
      "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
      "verified": "Kept deliberately small because only 14/67 tasks read this file. Targets platform-158, whose 2 scoring trials out of 10 are exactly the ones where the job log was read first and the region passed on. Also unblocks re-delegation, which the baseline's 'your only job after delegation is follow-ups' forbade. Honest limit: this is an LLM routing decision, so high variance, and it cannot help the 53 fast-pathed tasks at all."
    }
  ],
  "skipped": [
    {
      "title": "Cluster A: the regex fast-path routing to tool-less agents (~3.4 task-points, the largest cluster in the run)",
      "reason": "Requires a code change (evaluate patterns in priority order, fall through to the orchestrator on a multi-domain match, or permit sub-agent handoff). Outside this phase's prompt-only edit space. Escalated in FRAMEWORK_IMPROVEMENTS.md. The generalisable half of the affected rules was still written so it can pay off on held-out tasks that do reach the right agent."
    },
    {
      "title": "icinga-215's forbidden no-expiry item and cost-408's forbidden heading phrases",
      "reason": "Recoverable only by prescribing exact phrasings that satisfy a string matcher. That is grader-gaming rather than a mechanism fix, and would not transfer to the hidden set."
    },
    {
      "title": "platform-104's line citation",
      "reason": "Its graded line is a block start, which the final wording now matches, but the reader's line counting is unreliable. Expected gain ~0; kept only because the rule is cheap and correct for its siblings."
    },
    {
      "title": "ocpv_agent.md left untouched",
      "reason": "No OCPV task scores below 0.986; there is no cluster to fix and any edit would be unmotivated risk."
    },
    {
      "title": "platform-005, -117, -119, -134, -139, -165",
      "reason": "Single-trial dips with no identifiable mechanism. Per LEDGER guidance a move under 2*SE is not evidence in either direction."
    }
  ],
  "techniques": [
    "read the runtime routing code before trusting the prompt file names - found that 53/67 tasks never read orchestrator.md, which re-prioritised the entire edit budget",
    "joined per-trial verifier/reward-detail.json (missed rubric ids + unmatched expected calls) with agent/agent.jsonl transcripts and the task author's provenance.md into one digest per task",
    "6 parallel read-only diagnosis subagents (5 per-domain + 1 cross-domain mechanism sweep), then independent self-verification of every load-bearing claim",
    "separated zero-variance sub-1.0 tasks (systematic misses) from genuinely flaky ones instead of treating all 48 as noise",
    "preferred deleting/correcting false baseline rules over adding new prose - three of the biggest clusters were caused by the prompt itself",
    "2 parallel adversarial review subagents plus a final pre-ship check; reviewers executed target tasks' verify.py to settle regression questions empirically",
    "placed each rule in the narrowest file that is actually read for the mechanism, and moved the epoch section out of the shared prompt once no non-icinga task was shown to need it",
    "audited the final diff with grep for task-specific literals and replaced every example value that had been reverse-engineered from a graded answer"
  ]
}
